youtube_title: Popping That Pimple? Don't. Here's Why | Body Fix #32 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #32. Big pimple in the mirror... and your fingers are already going for it?
B is right. LEAVE it and keep it clean. Squeezing pushes germs deeper.
Popping = more swelling, DARK SPOTS and even SCARS.
Fix: Gentle wash twice a day, hands off, non-oily moisturiser, change pillow covers.
Red flags: Deep painful lumps, scarring, or it's hurting your confidence? See a skin DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - Acne / AAD
